title: Database issue: Could not get JDBC connection: pool exhausted after <*> ms
candidate_trigger: 2026-10-01 09:20:32,620 WARN  [payment-service] Slow query took 4200 ms: SELECT * FROM payments WHERE status = 'PENDING'

analysis.root_cause: The payment database ran out of connections: the HikariCP pool (50 connections) was exhausted, so new queries could not get a connection.
analysis.why: The first warning is a 4.2 s slow query on payments (line 79), followed 18 s later by 'pool exhausted' and 'remaining connection slots are reserved' from PostgreSQL. order-service and api-gateway errors start after payment-service, so they look like knock-on effects.
analysis.suggested_action: 1) Find and fix the slow SELECT on payments (add an index on status). 2) Check for connections that are not returned to the pool. 3) Temporarily raise the pool size or max_connections while the fix is deployed.
